'''Dribba Vermilic Scaiti''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of the [[Vermilic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] and the [[Author/Legends|author]] of ''[[Huttese Ain't What It Used To Be]]'', an account of how the writing schemes of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] had influenced the writing schemes of non-Basic speakers.
